title: Built a free tool that flags whether your backtest Sharpe is real edge or just overfitting (Monte Carlo permutation + PBO / Deflated Sharpe)
author: Normal_Ambassador349
selftext:
Got tired of not knowing if a good-looking backtest was real or curve-fit, so I built a small diagnostic that runs:

\- Monte Carlo permutation test (how likely your Sharpe is luck)

\- Bootstrap confidence intervals + equity cone

\- In-sample vs out-of-sample decay

\- Deflated Sharpe Ratio & Probability of Backtest Overfitting (PBO/CSCV, López de Prado)

Ran it on a sample strategy (Sharpe 0.49) and it flagged it as likely overfit: permutation p=0.19, PBO 53%, OOS decay -155%.

Happy to run it on your strategy for free — drop a daily-returns CSV or DM me. What do you all use to catch overfitting?
